Implementation 06, Phase 1. For each reference (blue frame), the passages of the song the code finds like it, in the order of the song. A score is from 0 to 1; a passage at 0.6 or more is kept (it would be in the dialog's list, ticked). Under the kept ones, with a dashed frame, the best places under the line: they would not be in the list. The parts of a score: the rhythm on the song's grid, the contour (the steps of the top line, or of the lowest for the left hand), the pitch classes, the harmony of the song; weights rhythm 0.3, contour 0.25, classes 0.2, harmony 0.25. "shift +2" means the passage plays the reference a tone higher. Each passage is drawn alone, from its first column.

What to look at: is each kept passage the same kind of passage as the reference? Is a passage under the line one you would want in the list?
